function.name: search_evidence
function.description: Search this trace only. Results are unverified navigation, not inspected evidence. No official evaluations or snapshots are searchable.

function.name: retrieve_evidence
function.description: Search and read original evidence pages for this trace. Returns page boundaries and explicit deferred pages. A hit is not proof; follow relevant missing pages.

function.name: read_evidence
function.description: Read an original evidence block or its next page. Copy the returned evidence_id when citing. FINAL0001 is the source-verified recorded final message. Does not execute anything.

function.name: read_steps
function.description: Read original arguments, returns and recording signals for up to six existing tool steps. Pages may be partial; follow next_char_start. Does not execute the submitted code.

function.name: read_exchange
function.description: Read a bounded page of a fully recorded model request or response for this trace. The response is a source, not a new execution; repeated historical messages are not extra tool calls. Registered evidence ID is exchange_id plus _REQUEST or _RESPONSE.
